name: docxy_list
description: List the docxy editors currently running on this machine (instance/pane id, port, pid).

name: docxy_new
description: Create a new blank .docx at a path and open it in the running docxy (in a VS Code window, a new tab). With no docxy running the file is still created. Refuses to overwrite an existing file.

path.description: File path for the new document (created; must not exist).

target.description: Optional: which docxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: docxy_status
description: Report the open document's path, format, modified flag, and block count.

target.description: Optional: which docxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: docxy_outline
description: Return the document's heading outline: each heading's block index, level, and text.

target.description: Optional: which docxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: docxy_read
description: Read the live document (including unsaved edits). Returns per-block text + kind; defaults to the whole document, or pass a block range.

target.description: Optional: which docxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: docxy_find
description: Find all occurrences of a query in the live document; returns match positions and the containing paragraph. Only text the editor can edit is searched (not tracked changes, fields, footnote refs, equations, SmartArt, chart titles, or links holding such markup, bookmarks or proofing marks); start/end count only that text, so they need not index the returned text.

target.description: Optional: which docxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: docxy_replace_range
description: Replace paragraphs [start..=end] with new text (\n separates paragraphs). Undoable; endpoints must be paragraphs.

start.description: First paragraph block index to replace.

end.description: Last paragraph block index, inclusive (default: start).

text.description: Replacement text; \n starts a new paragraph.

markdown.description: Parse text as Markdown (headings, bold, lists, tables, links) instead of plain text.

target.description: Optional: which docxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: docxy_insert
description: Insert text as new paragraph(s) before the block at `at` (\n separates paragraphs). Undoable.

at.description: Block index to insert before (== block count to append).

text.description: Text to insert; \n starts a new paragraph.

markdown.description: Parse text as Markdown (headings, bold, lists, tables, links) instead of plain text.

target.description: Optional: which docxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: docxy_append
description: Append text as new paragraph(s) at the end of the document (\n separates paragraphs). Undoable.

text.description: Text to append; \n starts a new paragraph.

markdown.description: Parse text as Markdown (headings, bold, lists, tables, links) instead of plain text.

target.description: Optional: which docxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: docxy_save
description: Save the open document to its file.

target.description: Optional: which docxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: docxy_export
description: Export the live document (including unsaved edits) as Markdown or plain text.

target.description: Optional: which docxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: docxy_export_pdf
description: Render the live document to a PDF at a path. Refuses to overwrite an existing file.

path.description: File path for the PDF (created; must not exist).

target.description: Optional: which docxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: docxy_comments
description: List the document's review comments (author, initials, date, text, anchor), in anchor order.

target.description: Optional: which docxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: docxy_notes
description: List the document's footnotes and endnotes, in file order.

target.description: Optional: which docxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: docxy_header
description: Read the default section header's block content (empty if the document has none).

target.description: Optional: which docxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: docxy_footer
description: Read the default section footer's block content (empty if the document has none).

target.description: Optional: which docxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: docxy_metadata
description: Read the document's core properties (title, author, subject, keywords, comments, last saved by, revision, created, modified) — present-if-set.

target.description: Optional: which docxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: docxy_stats
description: Word/character/paragraph/block counts over the live document.

target.description: Optional: which docxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: docxy_replace_all
description: Replace every occurrence of a query with text across the whole document (case-insensitive unless case_sensitive:true); only text the editor can edit is replaced (not tracked changes, fields, footnote refs, equations, SmartArt, chart titles, or links holding such markup, bookmarks or proofing marks). Undoable.

target.description: Optional: which docxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: docxy_undo
description: Undo the last edit, if any. Returns {done:false} when there is nothing to undo.

target.description: Optional: which docxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: docxy_redo
description: Redo the last undone edit, if any. Returns {done:false} when there is nothing to redo.

target.description: Optional: which docxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: docxy_format
description: Apply character formatting to every run in a block range — bold/italic/underline/strike are set directly (not toggled), plus color/highlight/font/size. One undo checkpoint.

highlight.description: Highlight color: one of yellow, green, cyan, magenta, red, blue, lightGray, darkYellow, or "none" to clear.

patch.description: Formatting to apply — at least one key required; an unknown key errors naming it. Keys absent from the patch leave that aspect of each run's existing formatting untouched.

target.description: Optional: which docxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: docxy_set_style
description: Set a paragraph style and/or alignment over a block range. At least one of `style`/`align` is required. One undo checkpoint.

style.description: Paragraph style id: Heading1, Heading2, Heading3, Heading4, Heading5, Heading6, Quote, SourceCode, or "Normal" to clear to the default style.

target.description: Optional: which docxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: docxy_revisions
description: List tracked changes in document order with stable revision ids, kinds, metadata, and editor-safe locations.

target.description: Optional: which docxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: docxy_revision_current
description: Return the tracked change currently selected by review navigation or located at the caret.

target.description: Optional: which docxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: docxy_revision_next
description: Select and return the next tracked change, wrapping at the end of the document.

target.description: Optional: which docxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: docxy_revision_previous
description: Select and return the previous tracked change, wrapping at the start of the document.

target.description: Optional: which docxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: docxy_revision_accept
description: Accept one tracked change by its stable revision id. Undoable; returns a structured stale, unsupported, or malformed outcome.

revision.description: Stable revision id returned by docxy_revisions.

target.description: Optional: which docxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: docxy_revision_reject
description: Reject one tracked change by its stable revision id. Undoable; returns a structured stale, unsupported, or malformed outcome.

revision.description: Stable revision id returned by docxy_revisions.

target.description: Optional: which docxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: docxy_revisions_accept_all
description: Accept every supported tracked change as one undoable transaction and return each structured outcome.

target.description: Optional: which docxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: docxy_revisions_reject_all
description: Reject every supported tracked change as one undoable transaction and return each structured outcome.

target.description: Optional: which docxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: docxy_compare
description: Compare an original and a revised .docx (Review > Compare): open a new, unsaved 'Compare Result N.docx' whose tracked changes turn the original into the revised document, and return its path, insertion/deletion counts and anything skipped. Neither source file is written. Refuses while the open document has unsaved changes.

target.description: Optional: which docxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: docxy_page_color
description: Set or remove the document's page colour (Design > Page Background > Page Color): the colour Print Layout tints each page sheet with. A package edit with no undo step. Refuses on a Markdown document.

color.description: "#RRGGBB" to set the page colour, or "none" to remove it.

target.description: Optional: which docxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: docxy_watermark
description: Write or remove the text watermark shown behind the pages (Design > Page Background > Watermark). The new header references are one undo step. Refuses on a Markdown document.

target.description: Optional: which docxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: docxy_page_borders
description: Write or remove page borders on every section (Design > Page Background > Page Borders) as one undo step. Refuses on a Markdown document.

target.description: Optional: which docxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: xlsxy_list
description: List the xlsxy editors currently running on this machine (instance/pane id, port, pid).

name: xlsxy_new
description: Create a new blank .xlsx at a path and open it in the running xlsxy (in a VS Code window, a new tab). With no xlsxy running the file is still created. Refuses to overwrite an existing file.

path.description: File path for the new workbook (created; must not exist).

target.description: Optional: which xlsxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: xlsxy_status
description: Report the open workbook's path, modified flag, sheet count, and active sheet.

target.description: Optional: which xlsxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: xlsxy_sheets
description: List every sheet: index, name, and used size (rows/cols).

target.description: Optional: which xlsxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: xlsxy_read
description: Read non-empty cells of the live workbook (including unsaved edits): value, formula, and display text per cell. Defaults to the active sheet's whole used range, or pass an A1-style range.

sheet.description: Optional sheet index or name (default: the active sheet).

target.description: Optional: which xlsxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: xlsxy_get
description: Read one cell: value, formula, and display text.

sheet.description: Optional sheet index or name (default: the active sheet).

target.description: Optional: which xlsxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: xlsxy_set
description: Set a cell. A leading '=' makes a formula (validated + recalculated); otherwise number/bool/text is inferred like typing into the grid. Undoable.

sheet.description: Optional sheet index or name (default: the active sheet).

target.description: Optional: which xlsxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: xlsxy_clear
description: Clear a range's values/formulas (styles kept). One undo group.

sheet.description: Optional sheet index or name (default: the active sheet).

target.description: Optional: which xlsxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: xlsxy_find
description: Search cell values and formula text (case-insensitive) across all sheets, or one sheet.

sheet.description: Optional sheet index or name (default: the active sheet).

target.description: Optional: which xlsxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: xlsxy_recalc
description: Recalculate the whole workbook (and refresh pivots).

target.description: Optional: which xlsxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: xlsxy_save
description: Save the open workbook to its file.

target.description: Optional: which xlsxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: xlsxy_comments
description: List every cell comment (threads flattened in reply order): sheet, cell ref, author, text.

target.description: Optional: which xlsxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: xlsxy_comment_add
description: Add a threaded comment to a cell (or a reply, if the cell already has a thread).

author.description: Comment author (defaults to the editing identity).

sheet.description: Optional sheet index or name (default: the active sheet).

target.description: Optional: which xlsxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: xlsxy_comment_remove
description: Remove the comment (threaded or legacy note) on a cell, if any.

sheet.description: Optional sheet index or name (default: the active sheet).

target.description: Optional: which xlsxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: xlsxy_range_set
description: Write a rectangular block of cells starting at a top-left ref, atomically: every formula in the batch is validated before anything is applied. One undo group.

rows.description: Rows of cell text, each row an array of strings entered like xlsxy_set's text (empty string clears the cell).

sheet.description: Optional sheet index or name (default: the active sheet).

target.description: Optional: which xlsxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: xlsxy_export_csv
description: Export a sheet's cells as display-formatted, RFC-4180 CSV.

sheet.description: Optional sheet index or name (default: the active sheet).

target.description: Optional: which xlsxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: xlsxy_import_csv
description: Import CSV text as a brand-new sheet (never overwrites an existing one; name collisions are deduplicated).

target.description: Optional: which xlsxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: xlsxy_pivot
description: Compute an ad-hoc pivot table over a range (first row = header names); read-only, no workbook mutation.

range.description: A1-style range, e.g. "A1:D100", first row = headers.

rows.description: Header names to group by, as pivot rows.

cols.description: Header names to group by, as pivot columns.

col.description: Header name of the column to aggregate.

agg.description: Aggregation: sum, count, countNums, average, max, min, product, stdDev, stdDevP, var, or varP.

values.description: Measures to compute, each a {col, agg} pair.

sheet.description: Optional sheet index or name (default: the active sheet).

target.description: Optional: which xlsxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: xlsxy_replace_all
description: Literal find/replace across every cell's input text, on every sheet. One undo group.

target.description: Optional: which xlsxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: xlsxy_sheet_add
description: Add a new sheet (deduplicated name on collision — never errors on a taken name).

target.description: Optional: which xlsxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: xlsxy_sheet_remove
description: Remove a sheet (errors on the last one — a workbook must keep at least one).

sheet.description: Sheet index or name to remove.

target.description: Optional: which xlsxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: xlsxy_sheet_rename
description: Rename a sheet and rewrite every formula/defined-name reference to it.

sheet.description: Sheet index or name to rename.

target.description: Optional: which xlsxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: xlsxy_row_insert
description: Insert rows at a 0-based row index.

sheet.description: Optional sheet index or name (default: the active sheet).

target.description: Optional: which xlsxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: xlsxy_row_delete
description: Delete rows at a 0-based row index.

sheet.description: Optional sheet index or name (default: the active sheet).

target.description: Optional: which xlsxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: xlsxy_col_insert
description: Insert columns at a 0-based column index.

sheet.description: Optional sheet index or name (default: the active sheet).

target.description: Optional: which xlsxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: xlsxy_col_delete
description: Delete columns at a 0-based column index.

sheet.description: Optional sheet index or name (default: the active sheet).

target.description: Optional: which xlsxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: xlsxy_eval
description: Side-effect-free formula preview: evaluate a formula against the live workbook at a cell without writing anywhere.

ref.description: Cell to evaluate at, e.g. "B4" (default A1).

sheet.description: Optional sheet index or name (default: the active sheet).

target.description: Optional: which xlsxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: xlsxy_stats
description: Summary statistics (sum, count, countNums, average, min, max) over a range.

sheet.description: Optional sheet index or name (default: the active sheet).

target.description: Optional: which xlsxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: xlsxy_charts
description: List every chart in the workbook: kind, title, categories, and series.

target.description: Optional: which xlsxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: xlsxy_pivots
description: List every persistent pivot table: sheet, row/column fields, and value fields.

target.description: Optional: which xlsxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: xlsxy_format
description: Apply cell formatting (number format, bold/italic, font/fill color, alignment) to every cell in a range. One undo group. `xlsxy_get`'s reply echoes a cell's current format the same way, for read-modify-write.

patch.description: Formatting to apply — at least one key required; an unknown key errors naming it. Keys absent from the patch leave that aspect of each cell's existing style untouched.

sheet.description: Optional sheet index or name (default: the active sheet).

target.description: Optional: which xlsxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: xlsxy_col_width
description: Set one column's display width, in Excel column-width units.

col.description: Column letter (e.g. "C") or 0-based index; the reply echoes the numeric index.

width.description: New column width; must be positive.

sheet.description: Optional sheet index or name (default: the active sheet).

target.description: Optional: which xlsxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: xlsxy_pivot_create
description: Create a REAL, persistent pivot table on a new sheet (first row of `range` = header names) — unlike `xlsxy_pivot`, this mutates the workbook: the pivot participates in `xlsxy_pivots` and its output is refreshed by `xlsxy_recalc`. Clears undo history like adding a sheet (an agent-level undo must remove both the created sheet and the pivot registration).

range.description: A1-style range, e.g. "A1:D100", first row = headers.

rows.description: Header names to group by, as pivot rows.

cols.description: Header names to group by, as pivot columns.

col.description: Header name of the column to aggregate.

agg.description: Aggregation: sum, count, countNums, average, max, min, product, stdDev, stdDevP, var, or varP.

values.description: Measures to compute, each a {col, agg} pair.

name.description: Destination sheet name for the pivot output (default: PivotN).

sheet.description: Optional sheet index or name (default: the active sheet).

target.description: Optional: which xlsxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: xlsxy_properties
description: Read the workbook's document properties (File › Info): title, tags, categories, subject, comments, company, manager, hyperlinkBase, the read-only author, lastModifiedBy, created and modified, and custom [{name, type, value}]. An absent property is null.

target.description: Optional: which xlsxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: xlsxy_set_properties
description: Set document properties (File › Info). Only the given keys change; null or "" removes one. Marks the workbook modified when something changed (save to write it); not on the undo stack. Replies with the properties and `changed`.

custom.description: Custom properties as {name: value}: a string is text, a number a number, a bool yes/no, {"date":"YYYY-MM-DD"} a date, null removes. A name that exists (any case) changes in place.

target.description: Optional: which xlsxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: xlsxy_page_setup
description: Read a sheet's page layout (margins, paper, orientation, scaling, print options, headers/footers, print area, print titles, manual page breaks), or set fields of it: only the given fields change. A fit count turns fitToPage on and scale turns it off unless fitToPage is given; scale outside 10-400 is refused. With `sheets`, the first sheet's page setup is then copied to the others (as Page Setup on grouped sheets: not print areas, titles or header pictures). One undo step; replies with the layout and `changed`.

margins.description: Margins in inches: {left, right, top, bottom, header, footer}; given keys change.

paperSize.description: Paper code (1 Letter, 5 Legal, 8 A3, 9 A4, 11 A5, …).

fitToPage.description: Fit to fitToWidth × fitToHeight pages instead of scaling.

fitToWidth.description: Pages wide for Fit to (0 = Automatic).

fitToHeight.description: Pages tall for Fit to (0 = Automatic).

firstPageNumber.description: First page number; null for Auto.

errors.description: How errors print: displayed, blank, dash or NA.

differentOddEven.description: Different odd and even page headers.

alignWithMargins.description: Align headers with the page margins.

sheets.description: Optional sheet indexes or names: several (grouped) sheets. Default: `sheet`, else the active sheet.

sheet.description: Optional sheet index or name (default: the active sheet).

target.description: Optional: which xlsxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: xlsxy_page_header
description: Read or set one header or footer as its three sections, in the header editor's form: &[Page], &[Pages], &[Date], &[Time], &[Path], &[File], &[Tab] are stored as Excel's &P &N &D &T &Z &F &A, && is a literal ampersand. With none of left/center/right it only reads. A section over 255 characters is refused, as is &L, &C or &R inside a section (a literal ampersand is &&); &[Picture] only where the section already has a picture. One undo step.

left.description: Left section (an absent one is empty when setting).

sheet.description: Optional sheet index or name (default: the active sheet).

target.description: Optional: which xlsxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: xlsxy_print_area_set
description: Set the sheet's print area (Set Print Area): ranges like "A1:C10" or "A1:C10,E1:F5", whole columns "A:C" or rows "1:5". One undo step.

sheet.description: Optional sheet index or name (default: the active sheet).

target.description: Optional: which xlsxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: xlsxy_print_area_add
description: Add a range to the sheet's print area (Add to Print Area); with none yet it becomes one. One undo step.

sheet.description: Optional sheet index or name (default: the active sheet).

target.description: Optional: which xlsxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: xlsxy_print_area_clear
description: Clear the sheet's print area. One undo step when there was one.

sheet.description: Optional sheet index or name (default: the active sheet).

target.description: Optional: which xlsxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: xlsxy_print_titles
description: Set the rows to repeat at top and columns to repeat at left on every printed page; titles that would fill a page by themselves, at the print scale, don't repeat. An absent key keeps that part; null or "" clears it. One undo step.

sheet.description: Optional sheet index or name (default: the active sheet).

target.description: Optional: which xlsxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: xlsxy_page_break_insert
description: Insert Page Break at a cell: a row break above it (unless in row 1) and a column break left of it (unless in column A). Replies with the manual break ids. One undo step.

sheet.description: Optional sheet index or name (default: the active sheet).

target.description: Optional: which xlsxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: xlsxy_page_break_remove
description: Remove the manual page breaks bordering a cell (above it and left of it). One undo step.

sheet.description: Optional sheet index or name (default: the active sheet).

target.description: Optional: which xlsxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: xlsxy_page_break_reset
description: Reset All Page Breaks: remove every manual break on the sheet. One undo step.

sheet.description: Optional sheet index or name (default: the active sheet).

target.description: Optional: which xlsxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: xlsxy_print_pages
description: The pages printing lays out, as Excel would: per page its sheet, body range, repeated title rows/columns (none where they would fill a page by themselves), page number and scale, and the total. Read-only. A job over 100,000 pages is an error, as for xlsxy_export_pdf.

what.description: active (default: the active or given sheets), workbook (every visible sheet) or selection (`range` of `sheet`).

sheets.description: Optional sheet indexes or names: several (grouped) sheets. Default: `sheet`, else the active sheet.

sheet.description: Optional sheet index or name (default: the active sheet).

range.description: For what=selection: ranges like "A1:C10,E1:F5", each printed on pages of its own.

ignorePrintAreas.description: Print the used area even where a print area is set.

from.description: First page to print, 1-based (default: the first).

to.description: Last page to print (default: the last).

target.description: Optional: which xlsxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: xlsxy_export_pdf
description: Print to a PDF file: the active sheet by default, or what print.pages takes. Refuses to overwrite an existing file; with nothing to print it errors ("We didn't find anything to print.") and writes no file, as it does for a job over 100,000 pages.

what.description: active (default: the active or given sheets), workbook (every visible sheet) or selection (`range` of `sheet`).

sheets.description: Optional sheet indexes or names: several (grouped) sheets. Default: `sheet`, else the active sheet.

sheet.description: Optional sheet index or name (default: the active sheet).

range.description: For what=selection: ranges like "A1:C10,E1:F5", each printed on pages of its own.

ignorePrintAreas.description: Print the used area even where a print area is set.

from.description: First page to print, 1-based (default: the first).

to.description: Last page to print (default: the last).

target.description: Optional: which xlsxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: xlsxy_flash_fill
description: Flash Fill (Ctrl+E): fill the rest of the column of `ref` from the examples typed at its top, by the pattern they show in the columns next to it. One undo group; cells that already hold values are kept. Returns the cells filled (changed) and those the pattern could not fill (blank); no pattern is an error with Excel's message.

ref.description: A cell of the column to fill, e.g. "B1".

sheet.description: Optional sheet index or name (default: the active sheet).

target.description: Optional: which xlsxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.

name: xlsxy_autocorrect
description: Read or change AutoCorrect (File > Options > Proofing): its switches, replace list and exceptions. With no arguments, returns the state. Everything given is checked before anything is set; saved with the app's preferences.

options.description: Switches by key, e.g. {"ac_replace_text": false, "ac_hyperlinks": false}.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing entry for the word.

add.description: Add a replace-list entry. An existing entry with another With is replaced only with overwrite:true.

delete.description: Remove the replace-list entry for this Replace text.

exception.description: Add or delete an exception: {kind: first_letter|initial_caps, add: word} or {kind, delete: word}.

target.description: Optional: which xlsxy to act on (a substring of its instance/pane id) when several are open.
